synopsis: Persival provides commercial sensor-model services, development and validation, with listed support for lidar, radar and cameras [f8551, f16104, f9096]. Its models follow ASAM OSI, are packaged as Functional Mock-up Units, and are explicitly supported as OSI FMUs inside any co-simulation host [f15948, f8706]. Its Avelon validation workflow correlates simulated and real sensor output and includes weather test benches; Persival is also described as a driver behind ASAM OpenMATERIAL 3D [f8553, f8554]. Despite these capabilities, Chapter 11 found no off-road evidence for Persival, and the glossary reports no public off-road validation for any of the named commercial sensor-simulation tools, including Persival [f8556, f8813, f9095, f15951]. Public pricing was not found, and a latest release is listed as not applicable, leaving cost and off-road suitability unresolved in the corpus [f8555, f9098, f9099, f8556].
